Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ENQUIRY Dear Sir, Please arrange to submit your best quotation for Refilling gas and HST of Cylinders as per below mention ed BOQ. GST Sl.No Description Qty Unit HSN % 01 Refilling of Argon gas (UHP grade : 9 01 EA 9.999% Pure) and Hydrostatic Testin g Argon Cylinder Cyl. Sl.No. 1605155 along with purity certificate & Testin g certificate

02 Refilling of Argon gas (UHP grade : 9 02 EA 9.999% Pure) in Cylinders Sl.No. 160 5211 & 1605167 along with purity ce rtificate 03 Refilling of Acetylene gas and Hydro 01 EA static Testing of Cylinder Sl.No. L100 95 along with purity certificate & Tes ting certificate 04 Hydrostatic Testing of Acetylene Cyli 01 EA nder Sl.No. L10096 along with Testin g certificate 05 Pickup and Delivery Charges 01 Trip TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Scope of Supply/Service: The scope shall include refilling of Argon (UHP grade : 99.999% Pure) and Acetylene gas cyli nders, hydrostatic testing of cylinders wherever specified, provision of applicable test certifi cates/purity certificates/COA, and pickup and delivery of cylinders as per the requirement m entioned in the BOQ. 2. Gas Quality & Purity: a) The gases supplied shall be of the specified industrial/commercial grade and purity as req uired by the Purchaser. b) The bidder/service provider shall furnish a Purity Certificate / Certificate of Analysis (COA) for each batch/lot of gas supplied. c) The COA shall clearly indicate, as applicable, gas name, grade, purity, major impurities, b atch/lot number, date of analysis, and name/authorization of the testing laboratory/manufac turer. d) The purity of the gas shall conform to the applicable relevant Indian/International Standar d or manufacturer's specification. 3. Cylinder Identification & Labeling: Each cylinder shall be properly and legibly labeled/marked with, as applicable: Name of the gas and gas grade/purity. Cylinder Serial Number. Batch/Lot Number of the gas. Date of filling/refilling. Hydrostatic Test Date / Next Test Due Date. Tare Weight / Water Capacity, wherever applicable. Gas quantity/pressure, wherever applicable. Appropriate hazard/safety identification and handling instructions. The labeling/marking shall be durable, clearly visible and shall not obscure the original statutory/manufacturer markings on the cylinder. 4. Hydrostatic Testing: a) Hydrostatic testing shall be carried out for the cylinders specifically identified in the BOQ and for any cylinder requiring testing before refilling, as per applicable statutory requiremen ts. b) Testing shall be carried out only at an authorized/competent cylinder testing facility havin g the required approval/accreditation, as applicable. c) A valid Hydrostatic Test Certificate shall be furnished for every cylinder subjected to testi ng. d) The certificate shall clearly mention the Cylinder Serial Number, test date, test pressure, t est result and next due date, along with the identification of the testing facility. 5. COA / Test Certificates: The successful bidder shall submit the applicable COA/Purity Certificate and Hydrostatic Test Certificate along with the delivery of the filled/tested cylinders. Documents shall be traceabl e to the respective cylinder/gas batch. 6. Cylinder Serial Number Traceability: The bidder shall ensure complete traceability between the cylinder serial number, gas batch/lot number, COA/purity certificate and hydrostatic test certificate, wherever applicabl

e. Any mismatch in cylinder identification or certificates may be treated as non-compliance. 7. Condition of Cylinders: Cylinders shall be returned in safe and serviceable condition. Cylinders shall be free from ex cessive corrosion, physical damage, oil/grease contamination or any other condition that ma y affect their safe use. 8. Pickup & Delivery: a) Pickup and delivery of cylinders shall be carried out by the successful bidder (service prov ider) from/to the location specified by AIESL. b) The bidder shall be responsible for safe handling, loading, transportation and unloading of cylinders during pickup and delivery. c) Transportation shall comply with all applicable statutory requirements for transportation o f compressed/flammable gases. 9. Compliance with Statutory Requirements: The bidder shall comply with all applicable provisions of the Gas Cylinders Rules, 2016, PES O requirements and other applicable statutory/safety requirements, as amended from time to time. 10. Defective/Rejected Cylinders: Any cylinder found unsuitable for filling or failing the hydrostatic test shall not be filled. The bidder shall immediately inform AIESL and submit the relevant test/rejection report. 11. Inspection & Acceptance: AIESL reserves the right to verify the gas quality, quantity, cylinder condition, labeling and c ertificates/documents at the time of delivery. Any cylinder/gas not conforming to the specifie d requirements may be rejected. 12. Documentation: The following documents shall be submitted wherever applicable along with the supply/servi ce: Certificate of Analysis (COA) / Purity Certificate Hydrostatic Test Certificate Gas batch/lot details Cylinder identification/serial number details Any other statutory/test certificate required under applicable regulations. 13. Responsibility for Quality: The successful bidder shall be fully responsible for ensuring that the refilled gas conforms to the specified purity/quality requirements and that all cylinders released for service are withi n their valid hydrostatic test period. 14. Taxes & Charges: The bidder shall clearly indicate GST, applicable taxes, transportation/pickup and delivery charges, wherever applicable, in the quotation. No additional charges shall be payable unles s specifically accepted by AIESL. 15. Validity of Documents: All certificates submitted by the bidder shall be genuine, valid and traceable to the respectiv e gas batch/cylinder. AIESL reserves the right to verify the authenticity of certificates with th e issuing laboratory/testing agency. Pick up and Delivery Address: Dy.GM(E-PPMM), AI Engineering Services Ltd., MRO Complex, Gate No 03, RGIA, Shamshabad, Hyderabad – 500108 Telangana. Contact 9160221608 Your immediate reply in this regard is highly appreciated. . 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
